name: @hobo/kv-redis-compatible
description: HoBo provider-neutral Redis-compatible key/value authoring and conformance: requirement builders for kv.redis-compatible/v1 and kv.valkey/v1, a declarative conformance suite of pure command cases driven by an injected executor, honestly-scoped consistency claims, and the guard that stops list/stream/pub-sub support from being read as a queue or topic capability.
